title: Suction-adhered device with suction power detection mechanism

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a suction-adhered device with suction cups and a detection mechanism, but it does not specify that it is cordless, handheld, or battery-powered.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: When the suction cup is loosened from a mounting surface, the indicating member is turned by an elastic element to show a warning indicating zone thereof, so that a user may be timely warned to re-mount the main body.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.quote: When the suction cup is loosened from a mounting surface, the indicating member is turned by an elastic element to show a warning indicating zone thereof, so that a user may be timely warned to re-mount the main body.

features.quote: From the red indicating zone 321 visible at the window 14, a user is warned about the loosened support unit 10.
features.note: The quote implies that the red indicating zone remains visible as long as the suction cup is loosened, meaning the warning indicator remains active.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: The suction-adhered safety or grab rail includes a handle bar, and two suction cups provided at two ends of the handle bar.
features.note: The reference describes a 'suction-adhered safety or grab rail' with a handle bar and suction cups, suggesting a portable device. However, it does not explicitly state it is a single-hand design or confirm the absence of external hoses or cords.
